CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bordereaux_ouverts_pour(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_platform text DEFAULT 'vinted'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user IS NOT NULL AND p_user <> auth.uid() THEN false
    WHEN coalesce(p_user, auth.uid()) IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN lower(coalesce(p_platform, '')) <> 'vinted' THEN false
    WHEN public.palier_de(coalesce(p_user, auth.uid())) NOT IN ('pro', 'business') THEN false
    WHEN coalesce((SELECT k.value FROM coin_config k WHERE k.key = 'bordereaux_vinted_tous'), 0) = 1 THEN true
    ELSE public.messagerie_beta(coalesce(p_user, auth.uid()))
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coins_awaiting_payment()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, tier text, canal text, next_grant_at timestamp with time zone, jours_retard integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.id,
         p.email,
         case when p.is_business then 'business' when p.is_pro then 'pro' else 'premium' end,
         case when p.stripe_customer_id is not null then 'stripe'
              when p.apple_original_transaction_id is not null then 'apple'
              when p.google_purchase_token is not null then 'google'
              else 'inconnu' end,
         w.next_grant_at,
         extract(day from (now() - w.next_grant_at))::int
  from profiles p
  join coin_wallets w on w.user_id = p.id
  where (p.is_pro or p.is_premium)
    and not coalesce(p.is_comped, false)
    and (p.stripe_customer_id is not null
         or p.apple_original_transaction_id is not null
         or p.google_purchase_token is not null)
    and w.next_grant_at is not null
    and w.next_grant_at < now() - interval '3 days'
  order by w.next_grant_at;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.debut_cycle_quotas(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT max(created_at) FROM coin_ledger
      WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND kind IN ('grant_monthly','grant_upgrade')),
    date_trunc('month', now())
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jauge_annonces_plafond(p_user uuid, p_tier text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH k AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'jauge_annonces_' || COALESCE(p_tier, 'free')) AS v)
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT jauges_actives() OR k.v IS NULL THEN quota_annonces_compte(p_user, p_tier)
    WHEN k.v = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE((SELECT q.quota_annonces FROM quotas_par_compte q WHERE q.user_id = p_user), k.v)
  END FROM k;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jauge_lens_plafond(p_tier text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN jauges_actives() AND COALESCE(p_tier, 'free') = 'business'
    THEN NULLIF((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'jauge_lens_business'), 0)
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jauge_publications_plafond(p_tier text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN jauges_actives()
    THEN NULLIF((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'jauge_publications_' || COALESCE(p_tier, 'free')), 0)
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jauges_actives()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'grille_trois_jauges'), 0) = 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.messagerie_beta(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user IS NOT NULL AND p_user <> auth.uid() THEN false
    ELSE coalesce((
      SELECT (p.beta_flags -> 'messages_bordereaux') = 'true'::jsonb
        FROM profiles p
       WHERE p.id = coalesce(p_user, auth.uid())), false)
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.palier_au_moins(p_user uuid, p_requis text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT (CASE palier_de(p_user) WHEN 'business' THEN 3 WHEN 'pro' THEN 2 WHEN 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      >= (CASE p_requis WHEN 'business' THEN 3 WHEN 'pro' THEN 2 WHEN 'premium' THEN 1 WHEN 'free' THEN 0 WHEN 'gratuit' THEN 0 ELSE 99 END);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.palier_de(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE
    WHEN p.is_business IS TRUE THEN 'business'
    WHEN p.is_pro IS TRUE THEN 'pro'
    WHEN p.is_premium IS TRUE OR p.is_comped IS TRUE THEN 'premium'
    ELSE 'free' END
  FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = p_user), 'free');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publications_du_cycle(p_user uuid, p_depuis timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT count(*)::integer
    FROM cross_post_jobs j
   WHERE j.user_id = p_user
     AND j.action = 'publish'
     AND j.created_at >= p_depuis
     AND (j.published_at IS NOT NULL OR j.status IN ('published', 'sold', 'pending', 'processing', 'needs_user'))
     AND NOT (COALESCE(j.platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) ?| ARRAY['opla_sortie', 'hors_quota'])
     AND COALESCE(j.handler_build, '') !~ '(sync-dressing|releve-annonces)';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quota_annonces_compte(p_user uuid, p_tier text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select q.quota_annonces from public.quotas_par_compte q where q.user_id = p_user),
    (select c.value from public.coin_config c where c.key = 'quota_annonces_' || coalesce(p_tier, 'free'))
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quota_annonces_consommees(p_user_id uuid, p_cycle timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH borne AS (
    SELECT GREATEST(
      p_cycle,
      to_timestamp(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'quotas_annonces_depuis'), 0))
    ) AS t
  )
  SELECT (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM usage_logs u, borne
      WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id AND u.feature = 'generate_listing'
        AND u.created_at >= borne.t
        AND NOT (COALESCE(u.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_titre', '') = 'true'
                 AND COALESCE(u.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_description', '') = 'true')
        AND NOT (
          u.metadata ? 'inventaire_id' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM usage_logs prev
            WHERE prev.user_id = u.user_id AND prev.feature = 'generate_listing'
              AND prev.metadata->>'inventaire_id' = u.metadata->>'inventaire_id'
              AND prev.created_at <  u.created_at
              AND prev.created_at >= u.created_at - interval '24 hours'
              AND NOT (COALESCE(prev.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_titre', '') = 'true'
                       AND COALESCE(prev.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_description', '') = 'true')
          )
        ))
    + (SELECT count(*) FROM usage_logs l, borne
        WHERE l.user_id = p_user_id AND l.feature = 'lens'
          AND l.created_at >= borne.t
          AND NOT (l.metadata ? 'unifie'))
  )::int;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quota_remontees_plafond(p_tier text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH k AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'jauge_remontees_' || COALESCE(p_tier, 'free')) AS v)
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN jauges_actives() AND k.v IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(k.v, 0)
    WHEN COALESCE(p_tier, 'free') = 'business' THEN NULL
    ELSE NULLIF((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'quota_republication_' || COALESCE(p_tier, 'free')), 0)
  END FROM k;
$function$
